panels.title: Mean stored mock churn probability
panels.description: Synthetic fixture predictions only; this is not model validation. UTC prediction time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', predicted_at) AS "time", AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mean mock churn probability" FROM churn_predictions WHERE prediction_source = 'mock' AND $__timeFilter(predicted_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scenario maximum face-value discount exposure vs budget
panels.description: Stored maximum allocated discount exposure and stated budget for each proposal, in USD. Neither is realized cost. UTC proposal time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", max_exposure_usd::double precision AS "Maximum face-value exposure (USD)", budget_usd::double precision AS "Scenario budget (USD)" FROM retention_experiments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scenario arm assignments (control, offer, no offer)
panels.description: Counts assignments across stored proposals in the selected UTC time range. A user may appear in more than one proposal; counts are not unique users or observed treatment groups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT assignment->>'arm' AS "Arm", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Proposed assignments" FROM retention_experiments e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'assignments') assignment WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scenario mean break-even hurdle by offer arm (pp)
panels.description: Mean stored algebraic increase in renewal probability required to break even on immediate gross renewal revenue, in percentage points. This is not measured or estimated treatment uplift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT assignment->>'arm' AS "Offer arm", ROUND((100 * AVG((assignment->>'required_absolute_uplift')::numeric)), 2)::double precision AS "Mean required uplift (pp)" FROM retention_experiments e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'assignments') assignment WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) AND assignment->>'arm' LIKE 'discount_%' AND assignment->>'required_absolute_uplift' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scenario baseline revenue at risk (not savings)
panels.description: Stored baseline estimate from each experiment proposal, in USD. No discount outcome or savings is implied. UTC proposal time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", (payload->>'expected_baseline_revenue_at_risk_usd')::double precision AS "Baseline revenue at risk (USD)" FROM retention_experiments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1
